scout.name: Scout
scout.description: Shallow scan. Passive, unauthenticated checks of DNS, the public surface, TLS and CORS. Quick and light, built for frequent runs.

sweep.name: Sweep
sweep.description: Light scan. Every passive check plus a review of how sign-in works, using one login.

probe.name: Probe
probe.description: Medium scan. Authenticated testing across two roles, with session, access-control and AI/LLM checks.

siege.name: Siege
siege.description: Deep scan. Every agent and all four logins, including business-logic and privilege-escalation testing, with the fullest report.
